title: a-record-reaches-disk
intention: Layer 0 of the spine's fix-upward map: a record written by the running system REACHES DISK and can be read back — the instrument every other layer's evidence is stated in terms of.
why: The spine trouble's verdict is FALSIFIED-not-by-a-break: the spine has never executed outside a proof, and every green in the suite is MECHANISM-GRADE ('this code behaves when called', reported as 'this is happening'). Layer 0 is first NOT because it is most broken but because every finding below it is validated 'via the logs' and there are no logs. There is no point instrumenting a crossing whose record has nowhere to land. Law 3: without this instrument, every liveness claim above it is an unmeasured hypothesis.

falsifier.proves_green: proof beside the code, sealed under the tester; acceptance is a LIVE read-back, not a constructed-and-called proof
falsifier.proves_red: Start the system, do nothing else, and read the log from disk. If no record written by the system itself (as opposed to by a proof calling in) is present, layer 0 is not built. A green that comes from a proof constructing the writer is exactly the mechanism-grade evidence this ticket exists to stop counting.
falsifier.horizon: before ANY higher spine layer is ticketed — this one gates the rest by the trouble's own ordering note
